name: Insomnia Club
storyline:
By day, you are a product manager living with chronic insomnia, responsible for translating human behavior into labels, requirements, and business decisions. By night, you enter a space open to those who cannot sleep and begin to know the people who might otherwise exist to you only as "user profiles."

Here, no one has to explain why they cannot sleep. You grow closer to several people who are also struggling to maintain a normal life—sharing food, exchanging messages, and testing one another's boundaries...

But the boundary between day and night will gradually dissolve. When your company's project begins to reach into the lives of real people at the club, the skills you possess, the trust you have earned, and the choices you make may help someone change their circumstances—or make their exploitation harder to see.
summary: Insomnia Club is a dark, grounded emotional visual novel about early-adult confusion, social issues, intimacy, and self-identity. You play as a long-term insomniac employee whose life gradually slips out of control as reality tightens around you.
